text: The most important aspect of carpentry is sanding. The sanding process is slow and can take several hours. When the time is up, the sawing process begins and the saw teeth come into play. The saw is an essential tool for carpentry, and is used in all types of woodworking, from carpentry to plumbing. The saw makes use of a wooden chisel, and a chain saw, and has a blade with a flat blade and a notch for cutting along the grain.
